card.name: Hyphen in non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs
card.fires_on: The word non and the hyphen right after it in "non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs", mostly in kidney-risk warnings about nephrotoxic agents. It also fires weakly inside "non-nucleoside".

modes.label: Hyphen after non
modes.description: The hyphen between non and steroidal in NSAID phrases listed as nephrotoxic agents.

modes.label: Inside non-nucleoside
modes.description: Partway through nucleoside after non- in drug class names.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word starts like para, though the effect is unclear.
